rules.identifiers: Tenant-owned object keys use opaque UUIDs. Never put organization names, user names, email addresses, phone numbers, lead names or original filenames in an S3 key.
rules.authorization: The backend must authorize organization, project and user ownership before issuing a short-lived presigned URL. A key prefix is not an authorization boundary by itself.
rules.database: PostgreSQL owns display names, MIME type, byte size, checksum, ownership and entity relationships. S3 stores bytes and operational manifests only.
rules.uploads: Server-validated bounded uploads may enter a canonical tenant prefix directly. Direct-to-S3 uploads enter temporary/ or quarantine/ and move only after server-side finalization.
rules.deletion: Database deletion and S3 deletion must use the stored opaque object key; never reconstruct a key from user-provided names.

prefixes.organizations/{organizationId}/shared/{a: Organization-owned files not tied to a project
prefixes.organizations/{organizationId}/projects/: Candidate evidence retained for an approved Discovery workflow
prefixes.organizations/{organizationId}/shared/pi: Organization-owned Pitch Deck images and mockups
prefixes.organizations/{organizationId}/shared/pa: Sensitive partner verification documents owned by the applying organization
prefixes.organizations/{organizationId}/shared/ac: Finalized videos for organization-owned Academy courses
prefixes.organizations/{organizationId}/users/{us: Organization-owned files scoped to a member
prefixes.users/{userId}/files/{assetId}/original: Private user files not owned by an organization
prefixes.users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/file: User-owned project files where no organization owner exists
prefixes.temporary/{uploadId}: Unfinalized uploads; expires after one day
prefixes.quarantine/{uploadId}: Rejected or suspicious uploads; expires after fourteen days
prefixes.exports/{exportId}: Temporary GDPR or administrative exports; expires after seven days
prefixes.migration/{source}/{migrationItemId}: Migration staging retained until explicitly finalized
prefixes._system/storage-layout.json: Authoritative storage layout and privacy contract

storeInS3: Lead attachments explicitly uploaded by an authorized organization member
Canvas PDF originals while keeping note metadata and extracted text in PostgreSQL
Pitch Deck mockups, before/after images, icons and cover logos
Partner verification documents with organization ownership
Videos uploaded to organization-owned Academy courses after temporary-object validation
Images uploaded for the organization prize catalog
Organization brand assets and approved Discovery evidence snapshots when those upload flows are introduced
Durable Leadbook exports only when the product promises later download
doNotPersistByDefault: CSV or XLSX import payloads after validation and commit
Unapproved Discovery crawl bodies or third-party page copies
Generated email attachments and previews that can be reproduced
Third-party logos referenced by URL unless an authorized user explicitly imports them
keepInPostgreSQL: Organizations, memberships, projects, leads, activities and authorization relationships
Discovery profiles, candidate scores, BRREG facts and approved evidence metadata
Canvas drawing state, searchable text and revision metadata because they are transactional application state rather than standalone downloads
Human-readable filenames, content types, checksums, ownership and S3 object relationships
Organization-level storage usage snapshots used for plan enforcement
